text.en: Pet owners consistently praise the veterinary surgeons and receptionists for their friendly, approachable, and reassuring manner. Multiple clients note feeling confident that their pets are in capable hands during routine visits and checkups. While a couple of reviewers felt let down during urgent situations, the overwhelming majority describe an attentive team.

title.en: Patient handling for dogs and cats

text.en: Reviewers emphasize how gently the clinical team handles animals, taking extra time to keep anxious, nervous, or vocal pets calm during examinations and vaccinations. Clients note that staff are patient even when pets resist injections, ensuring appointments remain stress-free for both pets and their owners.

Several clients praise the vets for listening attentively and explaining diagnostic options and treatments clearly without pushing unnecessary costs. However, a critical reviewer reported serious miscommunication regarding surgical advice and fee disputes, highlighting the importance of clear consultation dialogues.

q.en: How do staff handle nervous pets at Pets'n'Vets Blantyre?

a.en: Reviewers note that the team is patient, calm, and attentive with anxious, barking, or reactive pets during procedures.

q.en: Are routine pet vaccinations available at the clinic?

a.en: Yes, the practice regularly administers routine puppy, dog, and cat vaccinations and health checks.

q.en: Is there access to emergency veterinary care through this practice?

a.en: Yes, the clinic is part of the local Pets'n'Vets network with access to emergency hospital care at The Roundhouse in Glasgow.
